page_title: Dorothy - Your AI Agents, Perfectly Managed

summary.name: Dorothy
summary.one_liner: Dorothy is a desktop app for managing and orchestrating multiple AI coding agents such as Claude, Codex, and Gemini.
use_cases: Coordinating several AI coding agents on one project
Running multiple agents side-by-side in interactive terminals
Tracking agent work on a drag-and-drop kanban board
Automating processing of GitHub, JIRA, or Slack items with agents
Installing community skills for coding agents
summary.what_it_does: Dorothy is a desktop app that lets you run and manage multiple AI coding agents together. A Super Agent orchestrator accepts a task and delegates it to other agents. Each agent can run in a multi-agent terminal with full interactive access. A kanban board supports drag-and-drop task management, with agents auto-picking work by skill. Automations connect GitHub, JIRA, Telegram, and Slack so agents can process items automatically, and community skills from skills.sh can be installed with one click.
notable: Super Agent orchestrator that delegates tasks across agents
Kanban board where agents auto-pick work by skill
Supports Claude, Codex, Gemini, Ollama and local LLMs, mixed per project
Free and open source with no account needed
caveats: Platform support is only indicated by its listing under a macOS apps list; the page itself does not name platforms explicitly
The page does not describe detailed system requirements or setup steps
